# Public resource fixtures

The four workflows and default Codex root instructions were extracted from public PyPI
`novel_creator-0.10.0-py3-none-any.whl`, SHA256
`097e9d093424a04fdf0d50fcfbc47c3ed7fd0e6d4d081167b3a78cda497ce4d6`.
The opt-in previous-release verifier checks the actual frozen public artifact.
Offline tests render these public fixtures for each supported host/layout;
no real novel or debug content is included.
